evidence.observation: Stable, monotonic column profile (~79 °C mid, 67 °C top) with only slow drift over 20 min
Reflux ~0.15 L/h, distillate ~0.44 L/h, ratio steady ~6.8
Differential pressures steady (~0.7 / ~2.0 mbar), system pressure held ~598 mbar
Reboiler reads ~401 °C, implausibly high versus rest of profile — likely thermocouple/range artifact, otherwise consistent

args.missing_evidence: A distillate/bottoms composition measurement (GC) to assess separation; verification of T701 calibration/range to confirm the 400 °C reading is an artifact rather than a real process condition.
